Visitor replaces underline with custom markup

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_underline(self, ctx, text):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": f'_{text}_'}
    html = "<p>This is <u>very important</u> text.</p>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
